summary: Invoice total mismatch for May 2026 - unexpected credits applied
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that the invoice for May 2026 shows a lower total than expected. They expected ~$12,450 but were billed $8,720. They believe a set of credits were incorrectly applied. Impact: Finance and procurement at the customer are blocked from approving payment; may delay renewal discussions. Environment: Production billing pipeline and accounting export for customer account ID DS-9981. Steps to reproduce: 1) Export invoices for DS-9981 for May 2026 from Billing UI. 2) Compare line items between charge export and accounting CSV. 3) Observe three credit lines labeled "promo-credit-2026-04" totalling $3,500. Hypothesis: A stale promo credit from April was incorrectly backdated or applied to May via a batching job. Logs: billing-job logs around 2026-03-01 show a credits-apply operation for account DS-9981 with batch id batch-20260301-7a9f.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:22 - Aisha Patel: Opened ticket after receiving email from customer finance. Attached customer's exported CSV and invoice PDF. Requested triage and confirmation of whether credits should be reversed.
2026-03-10 10:05 - Marco Ruiz: Assigned. Initial triage: checking billing job runs and promo-credit records. Asking for account billing export and promo audit trail.

2026-03-11 14:40 - Elena Kim (eng-billing): Found job run where credits import referenced promo id PROMO-APR-42 applied to DS-9981 with effective_date 2026-05-01; likely data issue in promo import script. Investigating import pipeline (payments-sync).
2026-03-12 08:15 - Marco Ruiz: Notified customer of investigation and asked for patience. Offered to provide corrected invoice if fix confirmed.

2026-03-18 16:50 - Elena Kim: Root cause identified: promo import ETL mis-parsed CSV date field when timezone conversion applied resulting in effective_date shift by +30 days for some rows. Fix deployed to staging; creating DB migration to revert incorrect effective_date entries for affected accounts.

2026-03-20 11:30 - Marco Ruiz: Deployed hotfix to production to revert incorrect credit applications for DS-9981. Generated corrected invoice and shared with customer. Customer acknowledged receipt and asked for confirmation of final total.

2026-03-21 09:12 - Aisha Patel: Customer confirmed corrected invoice shows expected total $12,450 pending final payment. Closing steps: monitor next billing run and add postmortem and billing ETL test coverage.
